crossRefs.note: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one…
Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they…
Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law…
Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier…

translations.web: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
translations.bsb: and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.
translations.kjv: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
translations.asv: and had seen that some of his disciples ate their bread with defiled, that is, unwashen, hands.
